page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sccg7.32xlarge is an instance within the Super Computing Cluster family, built on the KVM hypervisor. It is provisioned with 128 dedicated vCPUs driven by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor, paired with 512.0 GB of system memory. This configuration establishes a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB of memory per core. The instance includes a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile, but features zero integrated GPUs and does not supply any local storage.

Without included local NVMe disks, architectural designs deployed on ecs.sccg7.32xlarge must rely on networked cloud block storage or distributed file systems. The high density of 128 dedicated execution threads combined with 64 Gbps baseline network capacity suits compute and communication tasks, though cost efficiency hinges on maximizing this large hardware profile. Workloads requiring local disk caching or GPU hardware acceleration are excluded by configuration. The server fits high-throughput compute clusters, distributed big data processing, enterprise web serving, and memory-balanced MPI simulation tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sccg7.32xlarge is a Super Computing Cluster instance running on KVM virtualization. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor, it delivers 128 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of RAM, yielding a standard 1:4 memory allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The node features a robust 64 Gbps baseline network interface. However, it does not include GPUs or bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage architectures for all persistent data operations. The high core count and substantial network pipe make the instance effective for compute-bound distributed jobs, batch processing pipelines, enterprise application serving, and large-scale data workflows that do not require local NVMe drives.
